// The figure of the numerical model, sampled from model.samples, with its root and the tangent at the root.
import std.viz
import model

pub fn figure(root: Float) -> String {
    xs = linspace(-2.5, 3.5, 121)
    ys = model.samples(xs)
    tangent = (xs - root) * model.df(root) + model.f(root)
    mut fig = viz.figure("model f(x) and its root")
        .describe("the numerical model sampled on 121 points, its root and the tangent at the root")
        .labels("x", "y")
        .xlim(-2.5, 3.5)
        .polished(caption: "f(x) from model.ostrin; root x = " + root.to_string(), label_size: 13, animate: false)
        .line(xs, ys, label: "f(x)")
        .line(xs, tangent, label: "tangent at the root", dash: "6 4")
        .scatter(array([root]), array([0.0]), label: "root", color: "#d1495b", size: 6.0)
        .hline(0.0)
    fig.svg()
}
